I told Pree in a thread on her message that the settled seat count for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87.

On Oct 14 Hollis first posted 268 in #central-team. Later that day he corrected it to 87 because he'd read the wrong line. I told Pree to ignore the 268. She's a member of #central-team, so both of Hollis's messages were already visible to her.

The old 268 entry is still in the knowledge base next to the 87 correction, because I couldn't retire it on the 14th. It should be removed so nobody puts the wrong number in the tracker.
